one_line: Timurid prince and founder of the Mughal Empire, commanding at the First Battle of Panipat in 1526.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, lean but wiry, with the posture and movement of a seasoned field commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, light brown to wheatish Central Asian complexion, faint crow’s-feet at the eyes, default expression calm but alert with a strategist’s sharp gaze.
appearance.hair: Dark brown hair, straight and medium length, tied back into a low knot beneath a tall, slightly conical Central Asian turban wrapped in deep green cloth with a fine gold edge and a simple jade-like cabochon at the front.
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved, knee-length Central Asian-style silk coat (chapan) in rich dark teal with narrow vertical gold stripes and a subtle woven floral motif, he wears a sleeveless, slightly padded dark maroon outer coat with a simple braided edging and side slits for riding; beneath is a cream-coloured, high-collared quilted under-tunic, with a wide leather belt dyed dark brown and fitted with small brass studs; his loose trousers are muted indigo cotton tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots with soft pointed toes; a light woollen shawl in muted saffron with a thin green border is draped over one shoulder, and he has a simple steel bracer on his left forearm, a small turquoise-studded ring on his right hand, and a narrow, functional dagger tucked at the back of his belt.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Central Asian-Timurid steel sabre (tulwar-like but with a simpler Timurid hilt), worn sheathed at his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard with understated brass fittings, which he sometimes rests his right hand upon when issuing commands.

ref_desc: Babur is a lean, early-40s Central Asian commander with an oval, bearded face, dark brown hair in a low knot under a tall green-gold turban, wearing a dark teal striped chapan, maroon outer coat, cream under-tunic, indigo trousers, brown boots, saffron shawl, and carrying a curved sabre in a brown leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Babur at the First Battle of Panipat: a lean, early-40s Central Asian war leader with an oval face, light brown complexion, high cheekbones, straight nose, short neatly trimmed beard and moustache, and sharp, calm eyes. His dark brown hair is straight, medium length, tied back into a low knot beneath a tall slightly conical turban wrapped in deep green cloth with a fine gold edge and a single jade-like cabochon at the front. Dress him in a long-sleeved, knee-length silk chapan in rich dark teal with narrow vertical gold stripes and a subtle woven floral motif, over a cream-coloured high-collared quilted under-tunic. On top, add a sleeveless, slightly padded dark maroon outer coat with simple braided edging and side slits suitable for riding. Give him loose muted-indigo cotton trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots with soft pointed toes. Around his waist place a wide dark brown leather belt with small brass studs, holding a narrow functional dagger at the back. Drape a light woollen shawl in muted saffron with a thin green border over one shoulder, and add a simple steel bracer on his left forearm plus a small turquoise-studded ring on his right hand. His signature weapon is a slightly curved Timurid steel sabre worn sheathed at his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard with understated brass fittings, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt; present him from multiple angles with consistent colours and details, ready to be reused across many panels.
